jessica (cs): Hey team — AcmeCorp flagged a month-end mismatch. Invoice shows a 'Pro plan surcharge' line for 0.9M tokens on 2024-06-30 but their dashboard aggregates show no matching charge. Can someone sanity-check?
paul (eng-billing): Paging @ken (finance) — do we have the invoice PDF and raw ledger for acct 7892? billing-bot: Invoice 7892 generated 2024-07-01 00:05 UTC — PDF uid=inv_7892_20240701. Ledger export available: /exports/ledger/2024/07/01/acct_7892.csv
ken (finance): I pulled the invoice. The line uses rate_id=pro-commit-monthly and shows a small overage surcharge. Dashboard shows the client's plan switched on 2024-06-28 at 15:12 UTC to Pro commit — maybe proration/backfill applied differently between systems.
jessica (cs): Customer says they upgraded at 6/28 11:12 local (US/Pacific). They expected pro pricing to apply from 6/28 forward; dashboard shows activity in the new plan window but total tokens are only in the 'standard' bucket historically.
paul (eng-billing): Likely root: metering window alignment vs plan-change effective time. We recently changed the backfill job to use UTC day boundaries for invoice lines; dashboard uses account timezone window for the UI. That can create a small delta if change happens near midnight.
sara (ops): Do we have a quick repro query to compare token counts by event_time bucket vs invoice_window? If we can show the delta per-day we can justify an adjustment or credit.
paul (eng-billing): Yes — running this query on metering DB helps. Example: 
```
SELECT
  date_trunc('day', event_time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') as utc_day,
  count(*) as events,
  sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM token_events
WHERE account_id = 'acct_7892'
  AND event_time >= '2024-06-27'::date
  AND event_time < '2024-07-02'::date
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
```
paul (eng-billing): Also run same with event_time AT TIME ZONE 'US/Pacific' to compare.
ken (finance): I compared ledger vs dashboard: ledger shows 900,312 tokens attributed to pro-rate window 2024-06-28 23:00:00 UTC-2024-06-30 23:59:59 UTC (system invoice window), dashboard UI shows tokens assigned to pro bucket for 6/29-6/30 in acct timezone. The overlap caused duplication of ~12k tokens being billed to surcharge.
jessica (cs): Customer is asking for refund/adjustment. They provided a CSV export from dashboard and the invoice PDF. I can attach to ticket.
paul (eng-billing): Short-term: offer a one-time credit for the delta and schedule a fix. Long-term: align invoice backfill job to respect account timezone when a plan-change event happens mid-cycle OR change dashboard to show invoice-window attribution.
sara (ops): Are there other customers impacted? We should run a scan: find plan-change events within 48h of a billing cutoff and diff ledger vs dashboard > 1%. I can queue a job.
ken (finance): Please queue that scan and send results to finance@redwood. If it's systemic, we'll issue bulk adjustments. For now, approve a manual credit to AcmeCorp for the 12,044 token overcharge (estimate).
jessica (cs): I'll communicate to customer: provisional credit and ETA for confirmation after scan.
paul (eng-billing): I'll create a GH issue with repro steps, link the SQL, and mark as P2 fix: "billing-window vs account-timezone plan-change attribution". Owner: paul.
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4423: billing-window-attr - assigned to paul (eng-billing).
ken (finance): Filing note — manual refund requires GL entry: REFUND-7892-0701. I'll do it after you confirm exact token-credit amount.
jessica (cs): Confirmed — attaching customer's CSV now. I'll update the ticket and reply to the customer with the provisional credit note. :thumbsup:
paul (eng-billing): Thanks. We'll aim to have the scan results and a proposed code change by EOD tomorrow. If anyone sees additional edgecases (timezones, trial->commit transitions), drop them in the GH issue.
ken (finance): Thanks all. We'll keep this thread updated.
